      About this item

      • Stunning 15.6" FHD IPS Display: Experience crisp 1920x1080 resolution on this 15.6 inch laptop with an IPS panel that delivers wide viewing angles and vivid colors. The narrow-bezel design maximizes screen real estate for comfortable viewing on this Win 11 laptop, whether you're studying or working.
      • Celeron J4105 Processor & 256GB SSD: Powered by a reliable Celeron J4105 processor paired with 12GB DDR4 memory and a fast 256GB M.2 SSD. This laptop computer supports SSD expansion up to 2TB and TF card expansion up to 1TB, so your storage grows with your needs. Delivers smooth multitasking for daily productivity.
      • AI-Powered Win 11 Laptop: Built-in AI features enhance your productivity with smart assistance for writing, summarizing, and task management. Pre-installed with Win 11 and includes Office 365 subscription. This student laptop is backed by 1-year warranty and 24/7 customer support.
      • All-Day 7000mAh Battery & 180° Hinge: The high-capacity 7000mAh battery keeps this laptop powered through long classes or meetings. The 180-degree lay-flat hinge lets you share your screen effortlessly during presentations. This durable laptop computer adapts to your dynamic workflow.
      • Versatile Connectivity Hub: Equipped with USB 3.2, Type-C, Mini HDMI, and 3.5mm audio jack to connect all your peripherals. Stay online anywhere with high-speed 5G WiFi and Bluetooth 4.2. This college laptop keeps you connected at home, in the library, or on the go.

      Warranty & Support

      Amazon.com Return Policy:You may return any new computer purchased from Amazon.com that is "dead on arrival," arrives in damaged condition, or is still in unopened boxes, for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Amazon.com reserves the right to test "dead on arrival" returns and impose a customer fee equal to 15 percent of the product sales price if the customer misrepresents the condition of the product. Any returned computer that is damaged through customer misuse, is missing parts, or is in unsellable condition due to customer tampering will result in the customer being charged a higher restocking fee based on the condition of the product. Amazon.com will not accept returns of any desktop or notebook computer more than 30 days after you receive the shipment. New, used, and refurbished products purchased from Marketplace vendors are subject to the returns policy of the individual vendor.

      How customer reviews and ratings work

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      5 out of 5 stars
      AKCHART 15.6'' AI Laptop
      This 15.6-inch budget laptop offers solid everyday performance for students and light office work with its crisp FHD IPS display, 12GB of RAM, and included Office 365; Processor & Speed: The quad-core chip handles web browsing, emails, and typing with ease ,Memory & Storage: 12GB of RAM lets you multi-task smoothly between browser tabs and documents and with built in AI helps to manage and finish tasks faster . The 256GB SSD boots up fast, but fills up quickly with large files. Battery Life: The 7000mAh battery lasts through a normal school day or light work session of about 5 to 6 hours.Ports: The modern Type-C port helps connect newer devices and chargers quickly.Wireless: Wi-Fi 5 keeps you connected to the internet securely, though it is slower than the newest Wi-Fi 6 routers. This laptop works great for typing papers, joining online classes, and streaming videos. Gamers and video editors should look for a stronger machine with a dedicated graphics card.

        5 out of 5 stars
        Incredible, Solid, and Easily Transportable. A Product I Would Not Want To Live Without Now.
        Reviewed in the United States on March 21, 2018
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Incredible product. Much more solidly built than I had expected.

        I purchased this because my 2017 MacBook Pro I-7 would warm up considerably during heavy work (I am a data scientist and push the machine to crunch very large sets before I move a project over to AWS for its computing power). This product was more than I expected. It is light weight, strong, and folds conveniently into a size that fits in an outer pocket of my backpack, thus I carry it with me wherever I go. Even when I am not crunching numbers, I place my Mac on it. The typing angle is perfect for long coding sessions and makes my hands feel much better.

        The item does adjust for the size of the laptop. My MacBook Pro is a 15 inch, but my ASUS laptop is a 17 inch. With a quick turn of the pressure dial on two of the legs, the X-stand adjusts between my Mac and ASUS so that each has a SOLID platform to rest on. And the room below the machines is ample to provide good airflow to keep the machines cooler.

        I wholeheartedly and enthusiastically recommend the X-Stand, especially if your "office" is more often on your back and your workstation is any desk surface you can find like mine tends to be. It conveniently folds into a small size and provides an adjustable, solid platform to air your laptop. I may purchase additional ones so for when (as too often happens) this great product is discontinued - should it every be - or for holiday gifts for my other geek friends.

      • Danny W.
        5 out of 5 stars
        PERFECT Stand/Easel for iPad Pro Artists and Creatives!
        Reviewed in the United States on January 1, 2016
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        So since the iPad Pro release I've been on a mission to find a good stand to simple prop the iPad up a bit for sketching. I'm a product designer by trade so I'm not doing insanely intricate work (mostly concept sketching) and after years of sketching a Cintiq, I'm used to sketching at somewhat of an angle. I originally purchased a stand that was marketed as an iPad Pro/Macbook Air Stand from a much more expensive (almost triple the cost) and well-known brand, but it fell short in more ways than one. THIS, however, is perfect for iPad Pro sketching. It works so well that in fact, I'm going to also write the seller to make sure they add it to the description.

        The problem with the "other" stand(s) is they simply aren't portable. Why would you want to buy a huge clunky stand (yes it might be pretty and textured aluminum and Apple make it more appealing by offering it in their online store) and not be able to just throw it in your bag? The Steklo X-Stand features very well thought out design and construction along with the portability you want for the products it supports. I do have one small gripe however, and that is the "feet" at the bottom that stabilize the laptop (by your wrists if you were typing) are a bit long. They stick out above the edge of the iPad Pro but for MacBook Pro customers this probably wouldn't be a huge deal depending on what model/how you type. For me personally I will probably Dremel them down a hair shorter so they're flush with the screen (I'm on the fence though as they do offer a good place to rest the Pencil) and still do their job of holding the unit in place. In all reality the feet haven't really bothered me yet on a physical level (I've only been using it for a few days) so I guess it's more of an OCD thing. The feet and back supports are soft polymer that provide plenty of grip/stability and I don't see them scratching any type of metal, but I use a case regardless.

        If you're looking for a great way to prop up your iPad Pro for sketching/drawing/painting whatever, you've found it! Don't go blowing all kinds of money on a more expensive stand when it's simply not necessary and lacks portability. I've added some customer images for anyone who'd like to see it modeled with an iPad Pro.
